question: Do Fast-DetectGPT conditional curvature and observer entropy, recovered from the top-20 candidates Workers AI returns, improve detection?

why_it_looked_promising.note: mean_entropy separates about as well as the strongest features already in the model (mean_log_rank 0.2375, mean_logprob 0.7525). Read alone, it looks like a clear win.

why_it_bought_nothing.reading: Curvature over a truncated head is close to a linear combination of two columns the model already reads (r^2 0.76 and 0.71). The 39-feature fit had already extracted the information.

controlled_ab.design: Identical 7055 rows, identical documents, identical fitting procedure; the only difference is whether the four top-20 features are present. Mixed-document rows disabled on both sides.

what_this_does_and_does_not_show: It shows that curvature estimated over the top-20 head THIS API exposes adds nothing on top of 39 existing features. It is not a refutation of Fast-DetectGPT, which is defined over the full distribution and is strongest when the observer is the generator.
The truncation is real and was measured: the top-20 candidates hold a median 88% and mean 82% of the probability mass, so mu and sigma2 are computed over a head, not a distribution.

In-domain detection is already saturated at 0.975 sentence AUROC, so that half of the A/B had no headroom to show a gain in either direction. The frontier set is the one that could have moved, and it did not.
cost_avoided: Completing the top-20 corpus rebuild would have cost several hours and a large share of the 10,000 neuron/day allowance to ship a measured zero.
